rationale: The order rewrote section 2 of Executive Order 10501 (which agencies may classify defense information) and revoked three presidential memoranda. Executive Order 11652 of March 8, 1972, section 14, expressly supersedes Executive Order 10501 as amended by Executive Order 10901 and others, as of its effective date June 1, 1972 (section 15). The memoranda revocation was a one-time act completed in 1961. The order therefore had no force on 2026-10-14. The two history observations (an Office of the Federal Register API disposition note and a 1989 Office of the Federal Register table entry) are editorial leads that give only an upper bound of 1989-01-20; I did not rely on them and instead read the later order's own text. The recommended status is NO; later amendments of the same lists (Executive Orders 10985, 11097, 11382) were checked and do not revive or continue anything after 1972.
